projects.title: Redlime Forge – Website Builder Platform
projects.summary: An internal website builder platform at Redlime Solutions. Every client site below is built, configured and published from this panel.
projects.description: Redlime Forge is the website builder platform behind Redlime Solutions' client work. It is a single React application that powers many independent sites: each domain loads the same runtime and renders its own pages, branding and content. As a Frontend Developer, I work on the builder panel and the shared rendering engine, building reusable, animated page sections that client sites are composed from. Access to the panel itself is restricted to the team.

projects.title: QR Studio
projects.summary: A browser-based QR code generator with custom colors, dot and corner styles, a center logo, and PNG/SVG export.
projects.description: QR Studio is a QR code generator that runs entirely in the browser. Users enter a URL and customize the foreground and background colors, export size, margin, dot style, corner style and error correction level, and can add an optional center logo. A live preview updates as they edit, codes export as high-resolution PNG or SVG with no watermark, and history is saved locally on the device.

This role strengthened my foundation in full-stack development and taught me the importance of security, scalability, and performance in financial applications.

papers.title: A Deep Learning Based Smartphone Application for Detecting Mango Diseases and Pesticide Suggestions
papers.description: This paper has proposed a new machine learning to classify diseases, insects, and their solutions. It includes a sufficient number of mango tree plants, insects, and diseases datasets with pesticide suggestions.
papers.publisherFull: International Journal of Computing and Digital Systems

papers.title: Identifying the Signature of Suicidality : A Machine Learning Approach
papers.description: This research proposes a machine learning-based prediction model in this respect. This research uses four traditional machine learning techniques to look at suicidality in various groups of people. To achieve higher levels of accuracy, we have included feature engineering in our suggested model.

papers.title: Lane Detection for Autonomous Vehicle Management: PHT Approach
papers.description: This research paper presents the design of a prototype autonomous guided vehicle which will detect and follow the lanes using the Probabilistic Hough Transform (PHT) algorithm. To do so, we convert our RGB road images into an HSV color model and then apply Gaussian smoothing to the converted grayscale image. For detection purposes, we process our region of interest (ROI) using a polygon clipping algorithm. Then, we apply Probabilistic Hough Transform upon the ROI image while setting all the parameters in our proposed lane detection algorithm.
